title: Restriction normalization under specified counits
statement: Given arbitrary categories A, B, C, D, functors Lr:A→B, Ls:C→D, Er:B→A, Es:D→C, isomorphisms rr:Er⋙Lr≅1 and rs:Es⋙Ls≅1, functors FX:A→C and FS:B→D, an isomorphism q:FX⋙Ls≅Lr⋙FS, and d:Er⋙FX≅FS⋙Es, define immersionComparisonNormalized to mean that for every M in B, Ls.map(d.hom.app M) ≫ rs.hom.app(FS.obj M) = q.hom.app(Er.obj M) ≫ FS.map(rr.hom.app M). This is the precise restriction-normalization equation; it asserts no existence of d.

def immersionComparisonNormalized
    {A B C D : Type*} [Category A] [Category B] [Category C] [Category D]
    (Lr : A ⥤ B) (Ls : C ⥤ D) (Er : B ⥤ A) (Es : D ⥤ C)
    (rr : Er ⋙ Lr ≅ 𝟭 B) (rs : Es ⋙ Ls ≅ 𝟭 D)
    (FX : A ⥤ C) (FS : B ⥤ D) (q : FX ⋙ Ls ≅ Lr ⋙ FS)
    (d : Er ⋙ FX ≅ FS ⋙ Es) : Prop
